en: Colorized historic street view showing a narrow cobblestone street lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops with striped awnings. In the background rises a large church or cathedral with multiple towers and spires. The caption at the top reads "Naumburg a. Saale. Steinweg und Dom.", indicating the scene is of the Steinweg street leading toward the cathedral (Dom) in Naumburg on the Saale River. Additional German shop signs are visible on the buildings.
